# Generated by bubble_ex from a Bubble app's data model. Deterministic:
# the same model and name map give the same file.
#
# One file holds many modules; split them one per file in your project
# (lib/my_app/task.ex, ...). The repo is referenced but not generated:
#   mix igniter.new my_app --install ash,ash_postgres
# then add these modules and run `mix ash.codegen --dev` while iterating.

defmodule MyApp.Privacy.KeyedRead do
  @moduledoc """
  Policy check: an authorized read (or aggregate) of the primary `:read`
  must select records by primary key (`Ash.get`) or load them through a
  relationship; direct view in Bubble reaches a record through a
  reference, never by listing. Otherwise it is forbidden. Enumerate
  and count with `:search`.
  Generated by bubble_ex (WTF-356); NOT VERIFIED AGAINST BUBBLE.
  """
  use Ash.Policy.SimpleCheck

  alias Ash.Query.{BooleanExpression, Ref}
  alias Ash.Query.Operator.{Eq, In}

  @impl true
  def describe(_opts), do: "the read selects records by primary key"

  # A policy check, not a preparation: it also sees aggregate queries
  # (count, exists, max, ...), which run no read hooks. A
  # relationship load (`accessing_from`) is keyed by the source
  # records' IDs, possibly as `id == parent(...)`.
  @impl true
  def match?(_actor, %{query: %Ash.Query{} = query}, _opts) do
    query.context[:accessing_from] != nil or
      keyed?(query.filter && query.filter.expression, query.resource)
  end

  def match?(_actor, _context, _opts), do: false

  defp keyed?(%BooleanExpression{op: :and, left: left, right: right}, resource),
    do: keyed?(left, resource) or keyed?(right, resource)

  defp keyed?(%Eq{left: %Ref{relationship_path: [], attribute: a}, right: v}, resource),
    do: key?(a, resource) and not Ash.Expr.expr?(v)

  defp keyed?(%Eq{left: v, right: %Ref{relationship_path: [], attribute: a}}, resource),
    do: key?(a, resource) and not Ash.Expr.expr?(v)

  defp keyed?(%In{left: %Ref{relationship_path: [], attribute: a}, right: v}, resource),
    do: key?(a, resource) and not Ash.Expr.expr?(v)

  defp keyed?(_expression, _resource), do: false

  defp key?(attribute, resource),
    do: [name(attribute)] == Ash.Resource.Info.primary_key(resource)

  defp name(%{name: name}), do: name
  defp name(name), do: name
end

defmodule MyApp.Privacy.SearchFields do
  @moduledoc """
  Policy check (a filter): Bubble lets a privacy rule keep fields out of
  the searches of the users it applies to (non-filterable fields). A read
  (`:read`, `:search`) whose filter or sort names such a field, as
  client input (`filter_input`, `sort_input`) or in code, directly or
  as the first step of a relationship path, returns only the records
  where the actor may search by it; one naming a restricted field
  further along a relationship returns nothing. Aggregates over such a
  field (`Ash.max/3`, ...) are not covered: generated code must not
  aggregate it for users who may not search by it.
  Generated by bubble_ex; NOT VERIFIED AGAINST BUBBLE.
  """
  use Ash.Policy.FilterCheck

  alias Ash.Query.{BooleanExpression, Exists, Not, Parent, Ref}

  # resource => field => groups: every group must hold, through one of
  # its privacy calculations (`:never`: no user may search by it).
  @restricted %{
    MyApp.Doc => [body: [[:privacy_rule_admin, :privacy_rule_owner]]],
    MyApp.Note => [text: [[:privacy_rule_mine]]]
  }

  @impl true
  def describe(_opts),
    do: "the read names only fields the actor may search by, where it matters"

  @doc "The restricted fields of `resource`: `[{field, groups}]`."
  def restricted(resource), do: Map.get(@restricted, resource, [])

  @impl true
  def filter(_actor, %{query: %Ash.Query{} = query}, _opts) do
    stack = [{query.resource, true}]
    expression = query.filter && query.filter.expression
    names = sort_names(query, stack) ++ names(expression, stack)

    case grants(names) do
      :deny -> false
      [] -> true
      groups -> Enum.reduce(groups, true, fn calcs, acc -> expr(^acc and ^any(calcs)) end)
    end
  end

  def filter(_actor, _context, _opts), do: false

  defp any(calculations),
    do: Enum.reduce(calculations, false, fn calc, acc -> expr(^acc or ^ref(calc)) end)

  # The groups the named fields need; `:deny` when one is restricted and
  # not on the queried resource itself, or nobody may search by it.
  defp grants(names) do
    Enum.reduce_while(names, [], fn {resource, name, root?}, acc ->
      case Keyword.get(restricted(resource), name) do
        nil ->
          {:cont, acc}

        groups ->
          if root? and :never not in groups,
            do: {:cont, Enum.uniq(acc ++ groups)},
            else: {:halt, :deny}
      end
    end)
  end

  defp sort_names(query, stack) do
    (List.wrap(query.sort) ++ List.wrap(query.distinct_sort) ++ List.wrap(query.distinct))
    |> Enum.flat_map(fn
      {field, _direction} -> field_names(field, stack)
      field -> field_names(field, stack)
    end)
  end

  defp field_names(name, [{resource, root?} | _]) when is_atom(name),
    do: [{resource, name, root?}]

  defp field_names(field, stack), do: names(%Ref{attribute: field, relationship_path: []}, stack)

  # `{resource, field, root?}` for every field an expression names, with
  # each step of a relationship path; `stack` holds the resources of the
  # enclosing `exists`, innermost first (root?: the queried resource).
  defp names(%BooleanExpression{left: left, right: right}, stack),
    do: names(left, stack) ++ names(right, stack)

  defp names(%Not{expression: expression}, stack), do: names(expression, stack)

  # An unrelated `exists(Resource, ...)` reads another resource.
  defp names(%Exists{related?: false, resource: other, expr: expression}, stack),
    do: names(expression, [{other, false} | stack])

  defp names(
         %Exists{path: path, at_path: at_path, expr: expression},
         [{resource, root?} | _] = stack
       ) do
    full = (at_path || []) ++ path

    case Ash.Resource.Info.related(resource, full) do
      nil -> [{resource, :__unknown__, false}]
      related -> hops(resource, full, root?) ++ names(expression, [{related, false} | stack])
    end
  end

  # `parent(...)` reads the enclosing resource; at the top level (a
  # relationship's own filter) it is outside the read.
  defp names(%Parent{expr: expression}, [_ | [_ | _] = outer]), do: names(expression, outer)
  defp names(%Parent{}, _stack), do: []

  defp names(%Ref{relationship_path: path, attribute: attribute}, [{resource, root?} | _] = stack) do
    path = path || []

    case attribute do
      %Ash.Query.Calculation{calc_name: nil, opts: opts} ->
        related = Ash.Resource.Info.related(resource, path)

        hops(resource, path, root?) ++
          names(opts[:expr], [{related, root? and path == []} | stack])

      attribute ->
        hops(resource, path ++ [field_name(attribute)], root?)
    end
  end

  defp names(%Ash.CustomExpression{expression: expression}, stack), do: names(expression, stack)

  defp names(%{__operator__?: true, left: left, right: right}, stack),
    do: names(left, stack) ++ names(right, stack)

  defp names(%{__function__?: true, arguments: arguments}, stack), do: names(arguments, stack)
  defp names(%Ash.Query.Call{args: args}, stack), do: names(args, stack)
  defp names(list, stack) when is_list(list), do: Enum.flat_map(list, &names(&1, stack))
  defp names(_other, _stack), do: []

  defp hops(_resource, [], _root?), do: []
  defp hops(resource, [name], root?), do: [{resource, name, root?}]

  defp hops(resource, [name | rest], root?) do
    case Ash.Resource.Info.related(resource, [name]) do
      nil -> [{resource, name, root?}]
      related -> [{resource, name, root?} | hops(related, rest, false)]
    end
  end

  defp field_name(%Ash.Query.Calculation{calc_name: n}) when is_atom(n) and not is_nil(n), do: n
  defp field_name(%Ash.Query.Aggregate{agg_name: n}) when is_atom(n) and not is_nil(n), do: n
  defp field_name(%{name: name}) when is_atom(name), do: name
  defp field_name(name) when is_atom(name), do: name
  defp field_name(_other), do: :__unknown__
end

      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? false
    end

  calculations do
    calculate :privacy_rule_owned_by_my_team_s_lead,
              :boolean,
              expr(owner_id == ^actor([:team_for_privacy, :lead_id])),
              public?: false,
              description:

  end

  actions do
    defaults [:destroy, {:create, :*}, {:update, :*}]

    read :read do
      description "Direct view: records reached by primary key (Ash.get, relationship loads); an authorized read or aggregate that does not select by primary key is forbidden"
      primary? true
    end

    read :search do
      description "Bubble \"Do a search for\": the records the user may find in searches"
    end
  end

  # Privacy rules compiled from Bubble by bubble_ex (WTF-356).
  # NOT VERIFIED AGAINST BUBBLE: do not ship these policies to users before
  # the replay verification (WTF-384/385) confirms the semantics they rest on.
  # Load the actor with the Privacy module's load_actor/1 on every request
  # and LiveView mount. Enumerate records only through :search; :read
  # returns records by primary key. Field policies do not guard code: a
  # filter, sort or calculation written in code (not *_input) that reads a

defmodule MyApp.Doc do
  use Ash.Resource,
    domain: MyApp,
    data_layer: AshPostgres.DataLayer,
    authorizers: [Ash.Policy.Authorizer]

  postgres do
    table "doc"
    repo MyApp.Repo

    references do
      reference :creator, ignore?: true
      reference :owner, ignore?: true
      reference :creator_for_privacy, ignore?: true
      reference :owner_for_privacy, ignore?: true
    end
  end

  attributes do
    attribute :id, :string,
      primary_key?: true,
      allow_nil?: false,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :created_date, :utc_datetime_usec, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true
    attribute :modified_date, :utc_datetime_usec, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true

    attribute :creator_id, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :slug, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :attachment, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :body, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :owner_id, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :public, :boolean, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true

    attribute :secret, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :title, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]
  end

  relationships do
    belongs_to :creator, MyApp.User do
      source_attribute :creator_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? true
      sortable? false
      filter expr(parent(privacy_rule_admin or privacy_rule_owner))
    end

    belongs_to :owner, MyApp.User do
      source_attribute :owner_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? true
      sortable? false
      filter expr(parent(privacy_rule_admin or privacy_rule_owner))
    end

    belongs_to :creator_for_privacy, MyApp.User do
      source_attribute :creator_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? false
    end

    belongs_to :owner_for_privacy, MyApp.User do
      source_attribute :owner_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? false
    end
  end

  calculations do
    calculate :privacy_rule_admin, :boolean, expr(^actor(:admin) == true),
      public?: false,
      description: "Bubble privacy rule \"Admin\" (admin_): its condition holds"

    calculate :privacy_rule_owner, :boolean, expr(owner_id == ^actor(:id)),
      public?: false,
      description: "Bubble privacy rule \"Owner\" (owner_): its condition holds"

    calculate :privacy_rule_public, :boolean, expr(public == true),
      public?: false,
      description: "Bubble privacy rule \"Public\" (public_): its condition holds"
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:destroy, {:create, :*}, {:update, :*}]

    read :read do
      description "Direct view: records reached by primary key (Ash.get, relationship loads); an authorized read or aggregate that does not select by primary key is forbidden"
      primary? true
    end

    read :search do
      description "Bubble \"Do a search for\": the records the user may find in searches"
    end

    update :auto_bind do
      description "Bubble auto-binding: an input writes one field of the record"
      accept [:body, :secret, :title]
    end
  end

  # Privacy rules compiled from Bubble by bubble_ex (WTF-356).
  # NOT VERIFIED AGAINST BUBBLE: do not ship these policies to users before
  # the replay verification (WTF-384/385) confirms the semantics they rest on.
  # Load the actor with the Privacy module's load_actor/1 on every request
  # and LiveView mount. Enumerate records only through :search; :read
  # returns records by primary key. Field policies do not guard code: a
  # filter, sort or calculation written in code (not *_input) that reads a
  # field the actor may not view still sees its value, so lowered searches
  # must not reference such fields directly, nor the private *_for_privacy
  # relationships. Aggregates (count, min, max, sum, ...) over a field are
  # not covered by field policies either: never aggregate a field the actor
  # may not view. Where Privacy.SearchFields guards a read, a filter or sort
  # naming a field some users may not search by returns only the records
  # where the actor may; aggregates over such a field are not guarded.
  policies do
    policy action(:read) do
      description "Direct view reaches records by primary key or through a relationship, never by listing"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.KeyedRead
    end

    policy action(:read) do
      description "Direct view (by ID, or through a reference): the user may view some field of the record"
      authorize_if always()
    end

    policy action(:search) do
      description "Searches: the user may find the record in searches"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_admin)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_owner)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_public)
    end

    policy action(:auto_bind) do
      description "Auto-binding: a rule letting the user auto-bind some field holds"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_admin)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_owner)
    end

    policy [action(:auto_bind), changing_attributes([:body])] do
      description "Auto-binding changes body: a rule letting the user auto-bind it holds"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_owner)
    end

    policy [action(:auto_bind), changing_attributes([:secret])] do
      description "Auto-binding changes secret: a rule letting the user auto-bind it holds"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_admin)
    end

    policy [action(:auto_bind), changing_attributes([:title])] do
      description "Auto-binding changes title: a rule letting the user auto-bind it holds"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_owner)
    end

    policy action(:read) do
      description "A filter or sort naming a field some users may not search by returns only the records where the actor may"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.SearchFields
    end

    policy action(:search) do
      description "A filter or sort naming a field some users may not search by returns only the records where the actor may"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.SearchFields
    end
  end

  field_policies do
    private_fields :hide

    field_policy [
      :created_date,
      :modified_date,
      :creator_id,
      :slug,
      :attachment,
      :owner_id,
      :public,
      :secret
    ] do
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_admin)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_owner)
    end

    field_policy [:body] do
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_admin)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_owner)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_public)
    end

    field_policy [:title] do
      authorize_if always()
    end
  end
end

defmodule MyApp.Memo do
  use Ash.Resource,
    domain: MyApp,
    data_layer: AshPostgres.DataLayer,
    authorizers: [Ash.Policy.Authorizer]

  postgres do
    table "memo"
    repo MyApp.Repo

    references do
      reference :creator, ignore?: true
      reference :creator_for_privacy, ignore?: true
    end
  end

  attributes do
    attribute :id, :string,
      primary_key?: true,
      allow_nil?: false,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :created_date, :utc_datetime_usec, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true
    attribute :modified_date, :utc_datetime_usec, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true

    attribute :creator_id, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :slug, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :text, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]
  end

  relationships do
    belongs_to :creator, MyApp.User do
      source_attribute :creator_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? true
      sortable? false
      filter expr(false)
    end

    belongs_to :creator_for_privacy, MyApp.User do
      source_attribute :creator_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? false
    end
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:destroy, {:create, :*}, {:update, :*}]

    read :read do
      description "Direct view: records reached by primary key (Ash.get, relationship loads); an authorized read or aggregate that does not select by primary key is forbidden"
      primary? true
    end

    read :search do
      description "Bubble \"Do a search for\": the records the user may find in searches"
    end
  end

  # Privacy rules compiled from Bubble by bubble_ex (WTF-356).
  # NOT VERIFIED AGAINST BUBBLE: do not ship these policies to users before
  # the replay verification (WTF-384/385) confirms the semantics they rest on.
  # Load the actor with the Privacy module's load_actor/1 on every request
  # and LiveView mount. Enumerate records only through :search; :read
  # returns records by primary key. Field policies do not guard code: a
  # filter, sort or calculation written in code (not *_input) that reads a
  # field the actor may not view still sees its value, so lowered searches
  # must not reference such fields directly, nor the private *_for_privacy
  # relationships. Aggregates (count, min, max, sum, ...) over a field are
  # not covered by field policies either: never aggregate a field the actor
  # may not view. Where Privacy.SearchFields guards a read, a filter or sort
  # naming a field some users may not search by returns only the records
  # where the actor may; aggregates over such a field are not guarded.
  policies do
    policy action(:read) do
      description "Direct view reaches records by primary key or through a relationship, never by listing"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.KeyedRead
    end

    policy action(:read) do
      description "Direct view (by ID, or through a reference): the user may view some field of the record"
      forbid_if always()
    end

    policy action(:search) do
      description "Searches: the user may find the record in searches"
      forbid_if always()
    end
  end

  field_policies do
    private_fields :hide

    field_policy [:created_date, :modified_date, :creator_id, :slug, :text] do
      forbid_if always()
    end
  end

    attribute :modified_date, :utc_datetime_usec, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true

      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :hidden, :boolean, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true

    attribute :text, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]
  end

  relationships do
    belongs_to :creator, MyApp.User do
      source_attribute :creator_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? true
      sortable? false
      filter expr(parent(privacy_rule_mine or privacy_everyone_else))
    end

    belongs_to :creator_for_privacy, MyApp.User do
      source_attribute :creator_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? false
    end
  end

  calculations do
    calculate :privacy_everyone_else,
              :boolean,
              expr(is_distinct_from(hidden, true) and not is_nil(hidden)),
              public?: false,
              description:
                "The Bubble \"everyone else\" rule applies: none of the rules hidden_ holds"

    calculate :privacy_rule_mine, :boolean, expr(creator_id == ^actor(:id)),
      public?: false,
      description: "Bubble privacy rule \"Mine\" (mine_): its condition holds"
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:destroy, {:create, :*}, {:update, :*}]

    read :read do
      description "Direct view: records reached by primary key (Ash.get, relationship loads); an authorized read or aggregate that does not select by primary key is forbidden"
      primary? true
    end

    read :search do
      description "Bubble \"Do a search for\": the records the user may find in searches"
    end
  end

  # Privacy rules compiled from Bubble by bubble_ex (WTF-356).
  # NOT VERIFIED AGAINST BUBBLE: do not ship these policies to users before
  # the replay verification (WTF-384/385) confirms the semantics they rest on.
  # Load the actor with the Privacy module's load_actor/1 on every request
  # and LiveView mount. Enumerate records only through :search; :read
  # returns records by primary key. Field policies do not guard code: a
  # filter, sort or calculation written in code (not *_input) that reads a
  # field the actor may not view still sees its value, so lowered searches
  # must not reference such fields directly, nor the private *_for_privacy
  # relationships. Aggregates (count, min, max, sum, ...) over a field are
  # not covered by field policies either: never aggregate a field the actor
  # may not view. Where Privacy.SearchFields guards a read, a filter or sort
  # naming a field some users may not search by returns only the records
  # where the actor may; aggregates over such a field are not guarded.
  policies do
    policy action(:read) do
      description "Direct view reaches records by primary key or through a relationship, never by listing"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.KeyedRead
    end

    policy action(:read) do
      description "Direct view (by ID, or through a reference): the user may view some field of the record"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_mine)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_everyone_else)
    end

    policy action(:search) do
      description "Searches: the user may find the record in searches"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_mine)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_everyone_else)
    end

    policy action(:read) do
      description "A filter or sort naming a field some users may not search by returns only the records where the actor may"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.SearchFields
    end

    policy action(:search) do
      description "A filter or sort naming a field some users may not search by returns only the records where the actor may"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.SearchFields
    end
  end

  field_policies do
    private_fields :hide

    field_policy [:created_date, :modified_date, :creator_id, :slug, :hidden, :text] do
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_mine)
      authorize_if expr(privacy_everyone_else)
    end
  end
end

defmodule MyApp.Team do
  use Ash.Resource,
    domain: MyApp,
    data_layer: AshPostgres.DataLayer,
    authorizers: [Ash.Policy.Authorizer]

  postgres do
    table "team"
    repo MyApp.Repo

    references do
      reference :creator, ignore?: true
      reference :lead, ignore?: true
    end
  end

  attributes do
    attribute :id, :string,
      primary_key?: true,
      allow_nil?: false,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :created_date, :utc_datetime_usec, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true
    attribute :modified_date, :utc_datetime_usec, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true

    attribute :creator_id, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :slug, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :lead_id, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :name, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]
  end

  relationships do
    belongs_to :creator, MyApp.User do
      source_attribute :creator_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? true
      sortable? false
    end

    belongs_to :lead, MyApp.User do
      source_attribute :lead_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? true
      sortable? false
    end
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:destroy, {:create, :*}, {:update, :*}]

    read :read do
      description "Direct view: records reached by primary key (Ash.get, relationship loads); an authorized read or aggregate that does not select by primary key is forbidden"
      primary? true
    end

    read :search do
      description "Bubble \"Do a search for\": the records the user may find in searches"
    end
  end

  # Privacy rules compiled from Bubble by bubble_ex (WTF-356).
  # NOT VERIFIED AGAINST BUBBLE: do not ship these policies to users before
  # the replay verification (WTF-384/385) confirms the semantics they rest on.
  # Load the actor with the Privacy module's load_actor/1 on every request
  # and LiveView mount. Enumerate records only through :search; :read
  # returns records by primary key. Field policies do not guard code: a
  # filter, sort or calculation written in code (not *_input) that reads a
  # field the actor may not view still sees its value, so lowered searches
  # must not reference such fields directly, nor the private *_for_privacy
  # relationships. Aggregates (count, min, max, sum, ...) over a field are
  # not covered by field policies either: never aggregate a field the actor
  # may not view. Where Privacy.SearchFields guards a read, a filter or sort
  # naming a field some users may not search by returns only the records
  # where the actor may; aggregates over such a field are not guarded.
  policies do
    policy action(:read) do
      description "Direct view reaches records by primary key or through a relationship, never by listing"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.KeyedRead
    end

    policy action(:read) do
      description "Direct view (by ID, or through a reference): the user may view some field of the record"
      authorize_if always()
    end

    policy action(:search) do
      description "Searches: the user may find the record in searches"
      authorize_if always()
    end
  end

  field_policies do
    private_fields :hide

    field_policy [:created_date, :modified_date, :creator_id, :slug, :lead_id, :name] do
      authorize_if always()
    end
  end
end

defmodule MyApp.User do
  use Ash.Resource,
    domain: MyApp,
    data_layer: AshPostgres.DataLayer,
    authorizers: [Ash.Policy.Authorizer]

  postgres do
    table "user"
    repo MyApp.Repo

    references do
      reference :creator, ignore?: true
      reference :team, ignore?: true
      reference :creator_for_privacy, ignore?: true
      reference :team_for_privacy, ignore?: true
    end
  end

  attributes do
    attribute :id, :string,
      primary_key?: true,
      allow_nil?: false,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :created_date, :utc_datetime_usec, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true
    attribute :modified_date, :utc_datetime_usec, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true

    attribute :creator_id, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :slug, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :email, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :confirmed_at, :utc_datetime_usec, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: false
    attribute :admin, :boolean, allow_nil?: true, writable?: true, public?: true

    attribute :name, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]

    attribute :team_id, :string,
      allow_nil?: true,
      writable?: true,
      public?: true,
      constraints: [trim?: false, allow_empty?: true]
  end

  relationships do
    belongs_to :creator, MyApp.User do
      source_attribute :creator_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? true
      sortable? false
      filter expr(parent(privacy_rule_me))
    end

    belongs_to :team, MyApp.Team do
      source_attribute :team_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? true
      sortable? false
      filter expr(parent(privacy_rule_me))
    end

    belongs_to :creator_for_privacy, MyApp.User do
      source_attribute :creator_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? false
    end

    belongs_to :team_for_privacy, MyApp.Team do
      source_attribute :team_id
      destination_attribute :id
      attribute_type :string
      define_attribute? false
      allow_nil? true
      public? false
    end
  end

  calculations do
    calculate :privacy_rule_me, :boolean, expr(id == ^actor(:id)),
      public?: false,
      description: "Bubble privacy rule \"Me\" (me_): its condition holds"
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:destroy, {:create, :*}, {:update, :*}]

    read :read do
      description "Direct view: records reached by primary key (Ash.get, relationship loads); an authorized read or aggregate that does not select by primary key is forbidden"
      primary? true
    end

    read :search do
      description "Bubble \"Do a search for\": the records the user may find in searches"
    end
  end

  # Privacy rules compiled from Bubble by bubble_ex (WTF-356).
  # NOT VERIFIED AGAINST BUBBLE: do not ship these policies to users before
  # the replay verification (WTF-384/385) confirms the semantics they rest on.
  # Load the actor with the Privacy module's load_actor/1 on every request
  # and LiveView mount. Enumerate records only through :search; :read
  # returns records by primary key. Field policies do not guard code: a
  # filter, sort or calculation written in code (not *_input) that reads a
  # field the actor may not view still sees its value, so lowered searches
  # must not reference such fields directly, nor the private *_for_privacy
  # relationships. Aggregates (count, min, max, sum, ...) over a field are
  # not covered by field policies either: never aggregate a field the actor
  # may not view. Where Privacy.SearchFields guards a read, a filter or sort
  # naming a field some users may not search by returns only the records
  # where the actor may; aggregates over such a field are not guarded.
  policies do
    policy action(:read) do
      description "Direct view reaches records by primary key or through a relationship, never by listing"
      authorize_if MyApp.Privacy.KeyedRead
    end

    policy action(:read) do
      description "Direct view (by ID, or through a reference): the user may view some field of the record"
      authorize_if always()
    end

    policy action(:search) do
      description "Searches: the user may find the record in searches"
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_me)
    end
  end

  field_policies do
    private_fields :hide

    field_policy [:created_date, :modified_date, :creator_id, :slug, :email, :admin, :team_id] do
      authorize_if expr(privacy_rule_me)
    end

    field_policy [:name] do
      authorize_if always()
    end
  end
end

defmodule MyApp do
  use Ash.Domain

  resources do
    resource MyApp.Board
    resource MyApp.Doc
    resource MyApp.Memo
    resource MyApp.Note
    resource MyApp.Team
    resource MyApp.User
  end
end

defmodule MyApp.Privacy do
  @moduledoc """
  Privacy rules compiled from Bubble to Ash policies by bubble_ex (WTF-356).

  NOT VERIFIED AGAINST BUBBLE. The policies rest on Bubble semantics not
  yet confirmed by replaying the app (WTF-384/385): do not ship them to
  users until they are. See `verified?/0`.
  """

  @doc "Whether the generated policies are verified against Bubble: not yet."
  def verified?, do: false

  @doc "The relationships of the actor that the policies read."
  def actor_loads, do: [team_for_privacy: []]

  @doc "The resource of the actor (Bubble's User)."
  def actor_resource, do: MyApp.User

  @doc """
  Reads the actor (a user or a user ID) afresh with `actor_loads/0`,
  bypassing authorization: the policies must see its current values.
  Call it on every request and LiveView mount, never reuse a stored
  actor. Returns nil (logged out) for nil or an unknown ID.
  """
  def load_actor(nil), do: nil
  def load_actor(%{id: id}), do: load_actor(id)

  def load_actor(id) when is_binary(id) do
    # bubble:ignores_privacy scaffold:load_actor
    case Ash.get(MyApp.User, id, load: actor_loads(), authorize?: false) do
      {:ok, actor} -> actor
      {:error, _} -> nil
    end
  end
end
